gaps_reported_by_model: The land transformation and occupation, the building, the heavy machinery, the concrete and its disposal all belong to the FIRST column (the conditioning plant infrastructure, per unit), not to this per-kg dataset; they reach it only through the 5.56E-07 unit of plant.
No direct emissions of any kind, in particular no radioactive releases, appear in the table.
The table is explicitly the ecoinvent v1.01 data with a known error (footnote 76).
